 Black Friday Early Black Friday deals are here from Amazon, Home Depot, Ulta and more: I found the best ones up to 70% off
 Beat the crowds in stores and online by getting a head start on shopping. It’s not a question of if popular products will sell out — it’s a matter of when. Updated   Nov. 16, 2026, 4:12 PM EST Zoe Malin
 Reporter
 Skip to table of contents In this article Best early Black Friday deals 
 Best early Black Friday sales 
 Why are these early Black Friday deals worth it? 
 Why trust NBC Selected?
 See 1 More Early Black Friday deals are officially here, and if you don’t start shopping before the holiday on November 27, you’ll be behind. The closer we get to Black Friday, the more products start running low or completely sell out, reducing your chance to save on tech, toys, appliances, beauty products, clothes, shoes and more. So start filling up your physical or virtual cart now — there’s not much time left before everyone else goes after the same items, too. 
 I frequently cover shopping events like Amazon Prime Day, Black Friday and Cyber Monday as a reporter for NBC Selected, so I know how to find deals that are actually worth buying. I spent weeks combing through thousands of discounts to find the best early Black Friday deals — each one I recommend below is highly rated and 20 percent off or more. When possible, I ran deals through price trackers to make sure they’re at their lowest price in at least three months or their lowest price ever. I’m updating this list live with my expert-approved picks.

 Best early Black Friday deals
 Roborock Q7 M5+ Robot Vacuum and Mop 
 Lowest price ever $ 199.99 $ 359.99 Amazon Now 44% off $ 249.99 $ 429.99 Roborock Now 42% off The most life-changing product I’ve used in 2026 is a robot vacuum and mop like this one. It picks up dirt, hair and crumbs while scrubbing floors to leave them sparkling — and the best part is that you don’t have to lift a finger. When the robot is done cleaning, it returns to its charging base and empties itself into the dustbag. It maps your home to detect where carpets, hard floors and obstacles are, and connects to an app that lets you set schedules and routines, as well as adjust settings.
 Hoka Arahi 8 
 $ 86.97 $ 149.99 Dick's Sporting Goods Now 42% off $ 97.50 $ 150.00 Zappos Now 35% off $ 120.00 $ 150.00 Hoka Now 20% off Hoka ’s Arahi sneakers are one of our favorite pairs, and since the brand recently released the ninth edition, the previous one is currently on sale. Hoka made minimal changes between the models, so it’s worth buying the Arahi 8 if you need a solid walking or running shoe . It has a built-in stability system that helps prevent overpronation, and a moderate layer of soft cushioning to absorb shock and keep your feet comfortable. The sneakers come in regular and wide styles, and men’s and women’s sizes.
 Lego Creator 3-in-1 Forest Animals: Red Fox 
 $ 34.99 $ 49.99 Amazon Now 30% off $ 49.95 Walmart Legos are one of the best holiday gifts for collectors and anyone who enjoys hands-on activities. This set comes with all the pieces you or your giftee needs to construct a red fox, which has a movable head, neck, legs, mouth, paws and tail when it’s done. It comes with a snow-covered tree stump and spruce tree stand, letting you display the fox in its habitat. The red fox is moderately challenging and best for those 9 years old and up.

 Stanley Quencher H2.0 Flow State Tumbler 
 Lowest price ever $ 22.50 $ 45.00 Amazon Now 50% off $ 33.75 $ 45.00 Stanley Now 25% off $ 45.00 Williams Sonoma As someone who’s owned a Stanley Quencher for at least four years, I can say with certainty that it withstands the test of time. Mine is just as durable as ever, and it continues to keep my drinks cold and ice frozen for hours thanks to its stainless steel construction and double-walled vacuum insulation. The water bottle’s narrow base is cup holder-friendly, and it has a lid you can move into three different positions: straw opening, drink opening and full-cover top. There’s also a large handle that makes it comfortable to hold.
 Godiva 2026 Holiday Chocolate Advent Calendar 
 Lowest price ever $ 43.50 $ 58.00 Amazon Now 25% off $ 58.00 Godiva Godiva dropped the price of its 2026 chocolate Advent calendar just in time for you to buy it before you have to start opening the little doors on December 1. The calendar is filled with milk, dark and white chocolate confections, like birthday cake bliss white chocolates, salted caramel milk chocolates and dark chocolate ganache truffles.
 Waterpik Cordless Pulse 3100 Portable Water Flosser 
 $ 29.99 $ 49.99 Amazon Now 40% off Waterpik’s water flossers are among the best you can buy, and many have earned the American Dental Association’s Seal of Acceptance, including this cordless model. There’s a reservoir on its handle that holds enough water for 45 seconds of cleaning, and a full battery gives you up to four weeks of use. The flosser comes with two interchangeable tips that rotate 360 degrees to reach all parts of your mouth, and it has two pressure settings.
 Ryobi One+ 18V Cordless 2-Tool Combo Kit with Drill and Driver 
 $ 99.00 $ 149.00 Home Depot Now 34% off $ 99.00 $ 149.00 Ryobi Now 34% off $ 134.94 $ 165.00 Walmart Now 18% off Ryobi’s drill and driver kit helps you get home improvement projects done fast and efficiently. It includes one 18-volt ½-inch drill/driver and one 18-volt ¼-inch impact driver, plus a charger and storage bag. The drill/driver delivers up to 515 pounds of torque, while the impact driver delivers up to 1,800 pounds of torque. Both tools have built-in LED lights to help you see your workspace clearly.
 De’Longhi Classic Signature Espresso Machine 
 $ 149.95 $ 229.95 Amazon Now 35% off $ 149.95 $ 229.95 Williams-Sonoma Now 35% off $ 149.99 $ 229.99 Target Now 35% off You’ll be an at-home barista in no time with De’Longhi’s Classic Signature Espresso Machine , which also has a built-in adjustable steam wand to froth or steam milk. You can brew single or double shots of espresso hot or over ice, and customize preset recipes to make your coffee routine as simple as possible. The machine has a large 57-ounce water tank and an adjustable drip tray, too.
 Blink Battery Doorbell 2K+ 
 Lowest price ever $ 34.99 $ 79.99 Amazon Now 56% off $ 35.99 $ 79.99 Target Now 55% off $ 35.99 $ 79.99 Best Buy Now 55% off What to know Ed’s note: This product is currently at its Prime Big Deal Days price, which we still think is a worthwhile deal.
 See, hear and speak to visitors when they’re at your door once you install Blink’s Battery Doorbell 2K+. It connects to an app that lets you livestream footage to your phone, and you see a head-to-toe view in crisp 2K resolution. The doorbell runs on three AA batteries, which last for years, according to the brand. 
 Gap 100% Cotton Softest Flannel PJ Set 
 $ 53.00 $ 89.95 Gap Now 41% off It’s almost time to get out your holiday pajama set , and Gap is discounting a handful of styles to help you refresh your collection. This one comes with a long sleeve shirt and long pants, both of which are made from 100% cotton. The set has a relaxed fit that won’t restrict you while sleeping, lounging or running errands. It comes in five festive prints, and there are matching options for men , kids , babies and toddlers .
 Shark Vertex Lift-Away Upright Vacuum 
 $ 269.99 $ 479.99 Amazon Now 44% off Not only does Shark’s vacuum clean your floors, but it also lets you get rid of dirt and grime under furniture, above doorframes and on stairs thanks to its detachable pod that you can tote around your home. The vacuum’s dual brushroll makes it safe for carpets and hard floors, and it comes with interchangeable tools like a pet crevice brush and dusting brush. The vacuum has LED headlights, strong suction and a HEPA filter, too.

 Why are these early Black Friday deals worth it?
 Black Friday is historically one of the biggest shopping holidays of the year online and in stores, and retailers start offering low prices weeks in advance to give shoppers plenty of time to take advantage of deals. All of my recommendations above are based on NBC Selected’s previous reporting. I prioritized including award-winning products and those our team has tested.
 When possible, I ran Black Friday deals through price trackers like CamelCamelCamel. I also evaluated the quality of each deal according to the following criteria, and only included those that:
 Are 20% off or more
 Are highly rated with at least a 4.0-star average rating from hundreds of customers on Amazon
 I wrote about every deal in this article and worked with NBC Selected editors to finalize the live list, which I’m frequently updating leading up to Black Friday to reflect the most up-to-date prices. For more information on our editorial team and how we choose products, check out this page .
 Why trust NBC Selected?
 I’m a reporter at NBC Selected who has covered deals and sales for over six years. I write about the best overall discounts during Black Friday, as well as chart the history of the sale and what to buy versus skip. I regularly appear in related NBC News NOW and TODAY Show segments, too. To curate my list of the best early Black Friday deals, I sifted through hundreds of options from various retailers to find worthwhile ones you should know about.
